nodes.label: Warp Design System
nodes.rationale: 'Restraint through warmth' — rejects the cold blue-tinted blacks typical of developer tools in favor of an earthy near-black and cream text, signaling the terminal is for everyone.

nodes.label: Matter Typeface
nodes.rationale: An unusual choice for a developer tool — its geometric softness signals the terminal is approachable rather than only for 'greybeards'.
